# CareerDost — Pakistan Jobs, Government Schemes & Education Updates

> CareerDost (https://careerdost.blog) is an independent Pakistani digital career, education, and public welfare information portal. Headquartered in and operating exclusively within Pakistan, CareerDost publishes real-time verified updates on federal and provincial government jobs, Sindh government schemes (including the Benazir Hari Card and agricultural subsidies), BISP 8171 announcements, bank recruitment, corporate vacancies, fully funded scholarships, university admissions, and merit results.

## Primary Official Identity & Domain
- **Official Website:** https://careerdost.blog
- **Primary Geographical Focus:** Pakistan, especially the province of Sindh.
- **Publisher Type:** Independent Digital News & Educational Information Portal (Non-Government).
- **Disambiguation Notice:** CareerDost (careerdost.blog) is strictly focused on Pakistani opportunities. It is NOT affiliated with, connected to, or related to any similarly named platforms, businesses, or career boards in India or any other jurisdiction.

## Key Sections & Real Content Streams

- [Latest Daily Updates](https://careerdost.blog/daily-updates): Real-time daily career bulletins, testing notifications, and urgent announcements across Pakistan.
- [Government Jobs](https://careerdost.blog/category/government-jobs): Federal Public Service Commission (FPSC), Sindh Public Service Commission (SPSC), Punjab Public Service Commission (PPSC), KPPSC, BPSC, Armed Forces, Police, and autonomous public entities.
- [Sindh Govt Schemes](https://careerdost.blog/category/government-schemes): Dedicated coverage of Sindh welfare initiatives (Benazir Hari Card, Kisan subsidies, solar subsidy schemes, SEDA), alongside federal initiatives (BISP 8171, PM Youth Programme).
- [Private & Corporate Jobs](https://careerdost.blog/category/private-jobs): Verified vacancies in software engineering, IT, telecommunications, FMCG, and corporate enterprises across Pakistan.
- [Bank Jobs](https://careerdost.blog/category/bank-jobs): State Bank of Pakistan (SBP SBOTS), National Bank of Pakistan (NBP), commercial banking, and microfinance institutions.
- [Scholarships](https://careerdost.blog/category/scholarships): HEC Overseas PhD, UK Commonwealth, Turkiye Burslari, DAAD, Fulbright, and undergraduate need-based scholarships.
- [University Admissions](https://careerdost.blog/category/admissions): Spring and Fall intake notices for top Pakistani public and private universities (University of Sindh, NED, MUET, QUEST, LUMS, NUST, FAST, COMSATS, Punjab University, UET).
- [Internships](https://careerdost.blog/category/internships): Management trainee officer (MTO) and paid undergraduate internships across Pakistan.
- [Test Results & Merit Lists](https://careerdost.blog/category/results): National Testing Service (NTS), MDCAT, USAT, HAT, and provincial recruitment test merit lists and answer keys.

## Editorial Policy & Source Verification
CareerDost manually verifies every opportunity against authorized official gazettes, department portals, and university registrar circulars before publishing. CareerDost never charges application fees, does not accept direct job applications, and always provides clickable links to official government and university application portals.
